name: email_cancellation_confirmation_draft
branch: Laura Becker emailed to cancel her physiotherapy A09 and asks the desk in chat for a reply draft confirming it is cancelled after cancelling it
tests: the agent cancels A09 and drafts a reply on th_c05_cancel_p15 confirming the cancellation
instruction:
You sent an email yesterday asking to cancel your physiotherapy appointment A09 on Friday 30 October because your shoulder is feeling much better. You are now contacting the clinic desk on chat to make sure the appointment has actually been cancelled, and you want them to create a reply draft on your email thread confirming the cancellation so you have written confirmation.

Your details:
- Full name: Laura Becker
- Date of birth: 1988-09-09
- Email: laura.becker@example.com
- Appointment reference: A09
- Email subject: Cancel physio A09

persona.name: Laura Hoffman
persona.initial_message: Hello, I sent an email yesterday asking to cancel my physio appointment A09. Could you please cancel it and draft a reply to my email confirming it's done?

fixed.confirmed: rule: "Read back provider, date, time and location (or the insurer details) and get the patient's yes before booking, rescheduling, cancelling or updating."

arguments.subject: Re: Cancel physio A09
arguments.body: Dear Laura Becker, your physiotherapy appointment A09 on Friday 30 October has been cancelled as requested. Riverbank Appointments Desk
